title: Create Aeroborne
description: A modpack I designed for playing with my friends, aimed to provide a fun building experience, aid exploration, and enjoy create under a new light
body:
Create Aeroborne is a modpack made by me with the goal of providing a fun experience of Create Aeronautics while keeping it optimized for adventure, building, and technology. Some features are:

-An unique end revamp, 'The Beyond', providing a more new and unique experience than most other 'end update' mods.
-A nether expansion, with the goal of keeping the core of 1.16 while also adding new, modern content.
-Create Aeronautics, the main attraction of this modpack: it allows you to build any airborne vehicles, whether its an airship, plane, or helicopter. To aid you in building, theres a multitude of addons such as Create Deco.

Currently in early development, planned to add a questline (no rewards, simply a basic guide), better main menu (current one is a placeholder), and more
